headline: Swedish Company Uses A.I. Likeness of Greta Garbo in Ad
context: An ad produced by the manufacturing company SKF Group featured a digital version of the Swedish American actress, who died in 1990. Not all viewers found the replica convincing.

sources.name: The New York Times
